related.title_zh: 日本全國數據：ASD 與 ADHD 新診斷趨勢——女性 ADHD 出現青年期第二高峰
related.title_en: Japan nationwide data: ASD and ADHD diagnosis trends 2010-2023
related.summary_zh: 信州大學團隊分析日本國家數據庫（NDB，覆蓋約 99% 人口）2010–2023 年度的新診斷記錄：自閉症譜系（ASD）1,621,682 人、ADHD 1,483,470 人，以 5–9 歲最多。女性 ADHD 自約 2017 年起在 20–24 歲出現第二個診斷高峰，2020 年起接近兒童期高峰；成人則自 2013–14 年度起 ADHD 診斷數超越 ASD。研究團隊強調，增加的是「接受診斷的人數」，不是特性本身變多；日本的支援與合理調整多以正式診斷為前提。
related.summary_en: A Shinshu University team analysed Japan's National Database (NDB, covering about 99% of the population) for new diagnoses in fiscal 2010-2023: 1,621,682 people with ASD and 1,483,470 with ADHD, peaking at ages 5-9. Among females, a second ADHD diagnosis peak at ages 20-24 emerged around 2017 and approached the childhood peak from 2020; among adults, ADHD diagnoses have exceeded ASD since 2013-14. The authors stress this is growth in people receiving diagnoses, not in the traits themselves, and note that support and accommodations in Japan generally require a formal diagnosis.
